title: Volunteers brave rain to help Rochdale Sea Cadets at Hollingworth Lake
excerpt: Rochdale Sea Cadets have thanked Get Together After Serving CIC after volunteers spent a wet morning clearing overgrowth around their boat shed at Hollingworth Lake.
body:
Rochdale Sea Cadets have thanked volunteers from Get Together After Serving CIC after they spent a wet morning clearing overgrowth around the unit’s boat shed at Hollingworth Lake.

The cadets shared their appreciation for the team’s efforts, saying: “We are so grateful to you for your help, you have done an amazing job.”

The clearance is a practical example of local groups supporting one another, with volunteers giving their time despite the rain.

Who else deserves recognition for helping our local community? Share your thanks in the comments.
editorial_source_note: Rochdale Sea Cadets statement supplied by the editor. The date of the clearance was not specified; publication date is not the event date.
